text:
Tomorrow is that-other day; perhaps

I would find, for the hyphaltic power,

an eternal entrance.


Tomorrow, some day,

the plated shop would be

with a pair of pericardia, a couple

of carnivores in heat.


All that may well take root.

But a tomorrow without tomorrow,

between the rings we are widowed of,

there will be a margin of mirror

through which I shall pass my own forehead

until I lose the echo

and remain with my brow toward my back.

translation.title: Trilce: Poem VIII — Tomorrow Is That-Other Day
translation.editorial_note: The invented hifalto is carried as hyphaltic rather than normalized; bodily futurity folds into the impossible mirror.
